notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional artifact.
description:
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing another artifact, causing you to mill three cards.
Cast Rite of Flame from your graveyard for its escape cost by paying {R} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard.
Saheeli triggers, creating a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
The Servo enters the battlefield, triggering Grinding Station, untapping Grinding Station.
Resolve Rite of Flame, adding {R}{R}.
Repeat.
